week: Day 12 of 100 · What decides the mark · Agents
title: Add three tools, then build the agent loop
task:
First half hour: Add three tools that read your JSON file: get_customer, lookup_order and process_refund. Run each one by hand and check what comes back.
Second half hour: Write the loop: send a message, run the tool Claude asks for, add the result, and repeat. Stop only when stop_reason is end_turn. Then ask for a refund that needs two tools and print stop_reason each time round.

week: Day 13 of 100 · What decides the mark · Agents
title: Build two helpers, then test what a helper knows
task:
First half hour: Make a main agent that starts two helper agents in one reply, using the Task tool. Put everything each helper needs into its prompt.
Second half hour: Leave one fact out of a helper's prompt and watch it fail. A helper knows only what you pass it. Put the fact back and run it again.
parts: Build 1.2 and 1.3: one main agent, two helpers
Test 1.2 and 1.3: what a helper knows

title: Make your flashcards, then lesson 1.4: forcing steps to happen, and handing over to a person

Second half hour: Read it, then do its quick quiz. Stop at 30 minutes, even if you are not finished.
parts: Lesson 1.4: forcing steps to happen, and handing over to a person

week: Day 15 of 100 · What decides the mark · Agents
title: Build and test 1.4: forcing steps to happen, and handing over to a person
task:

Second half hour: Ask for a refund without saying who you are, and check it is blocked. Then make the agent write a handover note for a person: customer, cause, amount, what to do next. Then read the lesson's common-mistakes box and answer its practice question.

week: Day 17 of 100 · What decides the mark · Agents

week: Day 30 of 100 · What decides the mark · Prompts and output

week: Day 31 of 100 · What decides the mark · Prompts and output
